question: What is the value of \[ \begin{aligned} &4 \cdot (-1 + 2 - 3 + 4 - 5 + 6 \\ &\qquad {}- 7 + \cdots + 1000)? \end{aligned} \]
solution:
Inside the parentheses, each negative odd number is followed by a positive even number that is one greater. Group these neighbors together:
\[
(-1+2)+(-3+4)+\cdots+(-999+1000).
\]
Every pair has sum \(1\). All \(1000\) terms are included exactly once, making \(1000\div2=500\) pairs. Thus the value of the original expression is
\[
4\cdot500=2000.
\]
The answer is \(2000\), choice E.
